name: Olympus Mod. joint seven-body one-shot training
authorization: Train Olympus with Nikon/Trepan-style joint architecture and physical objective; reuse resources; use new CPU/GPU; no independent re-verification or digest comparisons.

data.source: Previous 7000/500 branch pose splits, paired within split; no optical-quality filtering.
data.epoch_schedule: 7000 whole-system observations plus 7000 original isolated observations; alternate front/rear rehearsal each epoch.
data.observations: Actual noisy whole-assembly 9x128x128 uint16 packets; old isolated images remain labeled as isolated states.
data.validation_status: Reused component validation poses combined into joint cases; used for checkpoint selection; not a fresh independent test.
data.camera: Original 2048-pupil/4096-FFT renderer, unchanged fixed diffuser/relay/noise; original phase fit, bounded degree24/28/32/36 refinement on same state; no independent probe.

network.initialization: Both previous Olympus selected candidates and calibration
network.architecture: Two existing CNN/raw-image cross-attention encoders; same joint observation feeds both; new seven-body self-attention and residual action heads.
network.command: -clip(normalized prediction,-1,1); no ground-truth selection, endpoint clipping or feedback

training.objective: Trepan-style bounded log1p(center_PTTD_WRMS^2/.07^2) physical loss, plus .05 pose auxiliary and10 domain penalty; invalid physical paths receive penalty2.
training.physics: Existing full nonlinear24interface float64 trace,64pupil grid, center training and ninefield normal validation.
training.validation: 100fixed cases each epoch; all500 every5epochs and epoch0; select on full500 only.
training.tf32: Enabled for neural FP32 convolutions/matmul only; ray tracing remains float64.

resources.io: Bounded queues and block reading; no all-dataset RAM loading
resources.timing: Process effective time excludes standby; stages serial
